title: Sneaker Customizer with Stork Mascot
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D sneaker customizer using Three.js. The scene features a stylized sneaker built from primitives and a 'stork.glb' mascot model.

## Scene Setup
- Use a Three.js WebGLRenderer with antialias, filling the full viewport, background color #1a1a2e.
- PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2, 5) looking at origin.
- Add OrbitControls so the user can rotate the view.
- Add an AmbientLight (intensity 0.4) and a DirectionalLight at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 1.0 and castShadow enabled.
- A ground plane (CircleGeometry radius 3) with MeshStandardMaterial color #2d2d44, receiveShadow, rotated flat.

## Sneaker Model (Built from Primitives)
- Create a sneaker group at position (0, 0.3, 0).
- Sole: BoxGeometry(1.8, 0.15, 0.8) with MeshStandardMaterial, default color #222222.
- Upper: A stretched BoxGeometry(1.5, 0.4, 0.7) positioned on top of the sole, default color #ffffff.
- Tongue: BoxGeometry(0.3, 0.5, 0.05) tilted slightly back, positioned at the front-top, default color #ffffff.
- Laces: Three small BoxGeometry(0.4, 0.03, 0.05) strips across the upper, default color #ff0000.
- Swoosh: A flattened TorusGeometry(0.4, 0.03, 8, 32, Math.PI) on the side of the upper, default color #ff4444.
- The sneaker group should slowly auto-rotate around Y axis at 0.3 rad/s.

## Stork Mascot
- Load 'stork.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place it at position (2, 0, -1) with scale (0.8, 0.8, 0.8).
- The stork should gently bob up and down using a sine wave (amplitude 0.15, frequency 1Hz based on elapsed time).

## UI Panel (DOM Overlay)
- Create a fixed panel on the left side (width 220px, background rgba(0,0,0,0.8), padding 15px, color white, font-family Arial).
- Title: 'SNEAKER CUSTOMIZER' in bold.
- Part Selector: A <select id="partSelector"> with options: 'sole', 'upper', 'tongue', 'laces', 'swoosh'.
- Color Swatches: Five clickable div buttons in a row, each 35x35px with border-radius 50%, ids 'color0' through 'color4'. Colors: #ffffff, #222222, #ff4444, #3498db, #2ecc71.
- A button id='resetBtn' labeled 'Reset All' that resets all parts to default colors.
- A button id='toggleRotation' labeled 'Pause Rotation' that toggles the auto-rotation on/off. Text changes to 'Resume Rotation' when paused.
- A <span id='currentColor'> that displays the hex color of the currently selected part.
- A counter <span id='changesCount'> showing total color changes made.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- selectedPart: string ('sole','upper','tongue','laces','swoosh') - currently selected part
- partColors: { sole: '#222222', upper: '#ffffff', tongue: '#ffffff', laces: '#ff0000', swoosh: '#ff4444' } - current hex colors
- isRotating: boolean (default true)
- rotationAngle: number (current Y rotation in radians of sneaker group)
- changesCount: number (total color changes, starts at 0)
- storkLoaded: boolean (true once stork model is loaded)
- storkY: number (current Y position of stork)
- cameraDistance: number (distance from camera to origin)

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.

## Interactions
- Clicking a color swatch applies that color to the currently selected part's material.
- Changing the part selector updates selectedPart.
- Reset button restores all default colors and resets changesCount to 0.
- Toggle rotation button pauses/resumes auto-rotation.
- OrbitControls allow camera movement; cameraDistance updates accordingly.

## Animation Loop
- Update sneaker rotation if isRotating is true.
- Update stork bobbing.
- Update all __3D_STATE__ fields.
- Render the scene.
physics_constraints: Stork bobbing follows sinusoidal motion: baseY + 0.15 * sin(2π * t). Sneaker rotation increments at 0.3 rad/s when active. All color values must be valid hex strings. Camera distance must remain positive and finite.
